description: For a helper session that is not in the call: sets its own status board on the call page, shown as 'Helper <label>: <helper_name>' below the main agent; the main agent's board stays as it is. Same limits as status (doing max 400 chars, open / done max 10 items). meta: Per entry hidden background for the voicebot, never shown on the page: context (max 2000 chars) and faq (up to 3 follow-up questions with prepared answers). Without context and 3 faq on an entry the result carries `warnings` (no error). Empty doing, open and done removes the helper's board. Returns ok and, when context or faq is missing on an entry, warnings.

done.description: Background per done item, same order as `done`.
done.title: Done

open.description: Background per open item, same order as `open`.
